common_nuisance_ablation.nuisance_policy: one additive SN magnitude offset analytically profiled and counted in k
common_nuisance_ablation.conclusion: The nuisance/H0 policy mismatch was removed as a confounder. Under the same profiled-offset and fixed-reference-H0 logic, RLL still collapses to the LCDM-like limit for Pantheon+ Hubble-flow and remains effectively likelihood-equivalent to LCDM for Dovekie SN-only.

cpl_wa_boundary_sensitivity.conclusion: The historical wa=-3 optimum was boundary-sensitive: expanding the domain moves the profile optimum to wa≈-6. The parameter remains unbounded on the lower side at 95% over the tested grid, so wa must not be interpreted as measured.

scientific_boundary: This receipt closes two uncertainty questions but does not validate RLL, does not provide Bayesian evidence, and does not replace independent replication or perturbation-sector tests.
F_ok: Common-nuisance Pantheon+↔Dovekie ablation was materially executed and verified.
The former wa=-3 boundary ambiguity was tested on an expanded profile with all starts converged.
Negative/limited outcomes are preserved rather than promoted.
F_next: Extend the Dovekie wa profile farther into the negative domain until a left 95% exclusion is observed or the non-identifiability is characterized as an asymptotic degeneracy.
Keep nested-sampling evidence and independent replication as separate P0 authorities.
